name: Optimove
description: Analyze performance,  build campaigns, design customer journeys, size segments, configure triggers, craft templates, directly from Claude. Optimove  is available anywhere — an AI-native CDP & CRM grounded in your live customer data across email, SMS, push, web, and in-app.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Optimove to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Optimove to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.optimove.net/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Optimove MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Optimove provides these MCP tools: analyst, builder, expert, and explorer.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Optimove?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Optimove in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Optimove requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Optimove is developed by Optimove. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
